standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the determinant over kappa' of the base changed map on the simple quotient with the m-th power of the determinant over kappa.

core_obligations: Use flatness of R -> R' to base change the short exact sequences of the earlier lemma to short exact sequences over R', and use the multiplicativity of the determinant along these sequences to reduce to the case where (M, varphi) is a simple object of the category (proof lines 36732-36737).

In the simple case, note that M is annihilated by m, and choose a filtration 0 in I_1 in ... in I_{m-1} in R'/mR' whose successive quotients are isomorphic to kappa' as R'-modules, of length m by the hypothesis on the length (proof lines 36738-36743).

Tensor this filtration with M over kappa to obtain a filtration of M tensor_R R' = M tensor_kappa R'/mR' whose successive quotients are isomorphic to M tensor_kappa kappa', and observe that these submodules are invariant under varphi tensor 1 (proof lines 36744-36754).

Apply the multiplicativity lemma to the filtration to obtain det_{kappa'}(varphi tensor 1) = det_{kappa'}(varphi tensor 1 on M tensor_kappa kappa')^m, and use compatibility of determinants with field extensions to identify the latter with det_kappa(varphi)^m (proof lines 36755-36764).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a flat local homomorphism (R, m, kappa) -> (R', m', kappa') with m = length_{R'}(R'/mR') finite, and asserts that for an endomorphism varphi of a finite length module M over R as in the surrounding construction, the element det_kappa(varphi)^m maps to det_{kappa'}(varphi tensor 1) in kappa' (source lines 36721-36730). The proof first reduces to the case where (M, varphi) is a simple object of the ambient category: flatness of R -> R' ensures that the short exact sequences of the earlier lemma base change to short exact sequences over R', so the multiplicativity of the determinant along those sequences lets one descend to simple objects (proof lines 36732-36737). In the simple case M is annihilated by m, and the proof chooses a filtration of R'/mR' whose successive quotients are isomorphic to kappa' as R'-modules, of length m by the hypothesis (proof lines 36738-36743). Tensoring this filtration with M over kappa produces a filtration of M tensor_R R' = M tensor_kappa R'/mR' whose successive quotients are isomorphic to M tensor_kappa kappa', and the proof observes that the submodules are invariant under varphi tensor 1 (proof lines 36744-36754). Applying the multiplicativity lemma once more gives the displayed chain of equalities expressing det_{kappa'}(varphi tensor 1) as the m-th power of det_{kappa'}(varphi tensor 1) on M tensor_kappa kappa', which by compatibility of determinants with field extensions equals det_kappa(varphi)^m (proof lines 36755-36764). The non-routine content is the construction of the invariant filtration and its length count.
